campus-canon.content: VERIFIED CANON LESSON: For Block B Floor 2 geyser, tripping issues during winter are caused by phase load imbalance (space heaters on Phase 1), NOT heating coil failure. Solution: Shift geyser breaker to Phase 2 on subpanel DB-2B. Avoid ordering replacement heating coils.
